title: Fourth moment hypercontractive inequality
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$. Applying the noise operator with parameter $1/\sqrt{3}$, the uniform fourth moment of the resulting function is at most the square of the uniform second moment of $f$:
\[\mathbb E_x\big[(T_{1/\sqrt{3}}f(x))^4\big]\leq \big(\mathbb E_x[f(x)^2]\big)^2,\]
where $x$ is uniform on $\{-1,1\}^n$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is any real-valued function on the sign cube
expectations are with respect to the uniform measure on the sign cube
